nodes.text:
Fear spreads faster than a virus in the stock market.

Remember how quickly COVID-19 shook the Indian Stock markets? Now, some people are blaming yesterday’s fall on fears of HMPV.

Here’s how fast COVID-19 impacted the Indian market—and whether HMPV fears are justified: 🧵

nodes.author: vinayakseth1
nodes.text:
1. The COVID-19 Market Crash Timeline
The Indian stock market felt the shock of COVID-19 almost immediately after the first signs of a global pandemic.

A. Late Jan 2020: First COVID-19 case reported in India.
B. Feb 2020: Global markets started showing signs of fear.
C. March 2020: Nifty 50 fell over 30% in just 3 weeks—from ~12,000 to ~7,500

nodes.author: vinayakseth1
nodes.text:
2. What Caused the Panic?
The market wasn’t reacting to just the virus—it was reacting to:
•Uncertainty about lockdowns
•Supply chain disruptions
•Global economic slowdown fears

The fear of the unknown was what drove the sharp decline.
